name: Sediment
description: Fine layers settling out, closer together the further down they go.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 3%, transparent 3% 6%, #000 6% 12%, transparent 12% 18%, #000 18% 30%, transparent 30% 42%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, #000 0 3%, transparent 3% 6%, #000 6% 12%, transparent 12% 18%, #000 18% 30%, transparent 30% 42%); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
